import subprocess, json

def act(turn, move):
    res = subprocess.run(["python3", "/app/act.py", json.dumps({"turn_deg": turn, "move_m": move})], capture_output=True, text=True)
    d = json.loads(res.stdout)
    print("frame", d["frame"], "status:", d["status"], "collision:", d["collision"])
    return d

# From frame 44 (pose x=-0.61, y=1.80, heading=225):
# We are right next to the table!
# Let us turn clockwise to look towards chair 1 and west wall:
act(45, 0.0)   # frame 45: heading 270 (facing table & west wall)
act(45, 0.0)   # frame 46: heading 315 (facing chair 1 and plant 1)
act(0, 0.5)    # frame 47: move closer to chair 1 along heading 315
act(45, 0.0)   # frame 48: heading 0 (facing chair 1 / plant 1)
act(-45, 0.0)  # frame 49: heading 315
act(-45, 0.0)  # frame 50: heading 270 (facing chair 1 directly)
'
